ai-data / Warehouse

dbt

Business definitions maintained as analytical code.

dOfficial product ↗Open in the hierarchy →
Level 4Inspect the detail

Transform warehouse data into tested, documented business models with dbt's analytics-engineering workflow. MoreSpace can build a reusable reporting layer for acquisition, pipeline, revenue, and product measures so each dashboard starts from consistent definitions. We organize source relationships, model dependencies, data tests, and version-controlled changes, then review the commercial meaning of every measure with the team that uses it.

Useful outputs

  • Reusable analytical data models
  • Tests and model documentation
  • Dependency and quality reports

Where we can apply it

  • Raw campaign and CRM data → tested models → consistent KPIs → channel dashboard.
  • Revenue sources → documented transformations → finance reconciliation → reporting mart.
  • Source change → model review → meaningful data tests → controlled analytics release.
01

Use case 1

Model clean lead, customer, revenue, and campaign tables.

02

Use case 2

Test key assumptions such as uniqueness and required fields.

03

Use case 3

Document model dependencies and consistent metric definitions.

Inputs we need

  • Approved warehouse source tables
  • Metric and model definitions
  • Version-control and deployment rules

Delivery sequence

  • Define the reporting entities and resolve conflicting business meanings.
  • Create version-controlled models with relevant source and model tests.
  • Review changed measures, run checks, and deploy approved transformations.

Expert review points

  • Validate key totals and cohort logic with the business owner.
  • Treat failed tests and stale inputs as visible reporting exceptions.

We confirm available integrations, plans, permissions, and data mapping before implementing these connection candidates.

  • Google BigQuery
  • Snowflake
  • GitHub
  • BI reporting tools

Signals we can make visible

  • Data test pass rate
  • Data completeness
  • Model refresh success
  • Reconciliation variance

We agree the source, population, period, denominator, and decision behind each measure.
